text:
anya: Huge thanks to @sanjay and @leo for covering the late-night oncall and saving the demo — you literally kept the deploy from melting down and brought emergency bagels at 1:12am :bagel: :trophy:

sanjay: lol happy to help. was a weird cache miss — leo found a stray env var. also shoutout to @devon for rerouting the noisy alerts so we could focus. :raised_hands:

leo: confirmed. env var `REDWOOD_CACHE_TTL` was set to `0` in one container. fixed, restarted, golden. :sparkles:

devon: quick note — adjusted alert routing to reduce duplicates. if anyone sees noise ping me and I’ll tweak. :phone:

maria: massive props to @anya for coordinating the midnight snack run and for sharing doggo pics during the lull. morale went up 200% :dog: :heart_eyes:

anya: posting the pic here so the team can recharge: https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T1234-F5678/doggo_rescue.jpg :blob_heart:

ops-bot: Alert routing update: moved #prod-high to OnCallTeamB until 2025-11-15T08:00Z. (Auto-notify: oncall-sched)

leo: also grabbing a quick callout to @sanjay — stayed on the thread until the last test passed. appreciate the late hours. :clap:

sanjay: thanks! team effort. and if anyone wants leftover bagels, there’s a box in the 3rd floor kitchen — help yourselves. :yum:

anya: tiny +1 to that, and again huge thanks everyone. we should add this as a case study: `how dog pics and carbs save demos` :grin:

maria: adding to the gratitude board now. :sparkles:
